task_prompt:

Draft a concise, professional email body addressed to James Wilson at Zeta Technologies requesting updated dashboard specification questions. Maintain strict focus on analytics collaboration; explicitly exclude any references to marketing budget discussions or internal sprint notes. Adopt a natural, client-facing tone that is professional yet approachable. Structure as complete external business correspondence suitable for immediate sending.
answer:
Subject: Dashboard Analytics Collaboration – Quick Questions

Hi James,

I hope this message finds you well. I'm reaching out regarding the analytics dashboard we discussed, and I had a few quick questions to make sure we're building exactly what your team needs.

Could we schedule a brief 15-minute sync to clarify a few specification details? Specifically, I'd love to confirm:

• Which key metrics and KPIs you need prioritized on the main view
• Your preferred visualization types for trend analysis (line charts, bar graphs, heatmaps, etc.)
• Any specific data sources or integrations that need to be included upfront
• Timeline expectations for the initial MVP rollout

I want to ensure we're aligned on requirements before we finalize the build phase. Would sometime Thursday or Friday this week work for you? I'm flexible on timing.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Best regards
